ledgerCheck: No earlier reviews and stages.fixes is empty, so there are no ledger claims to confirm in round 1.

issues.problem: Frozen rrweb seeks render a different scroll state in the final render than the one shot authors measured in the harness. The 'schedule' take at add-env 11458 shows the project tab strip ('Test Runs' / 'Playwri…') where the shot code expects the schedule chip (ch04-s01.tsx notes 'sheet scroller sits at scrollTop 700' in the harness). This breaks ch04-s01 and ch04-s02, the ch01-s03 stamp ('…st Runs') and probably the ch04-s03 brace (about one row too high).
issues.fix: Make RrwebScreen seeks deterministic across harness, sheet and render: replay scroll events sequentially up to `at`, or pin a per-mark scrollTop in rr-clean, and make the sheet path match the render path. Then re-verify every crop against frames pulled from render/film.mp4 with ffmpeg, not from harness probes.

issues.problem: The 'name tag' under 3:00 AM is a clipped strip of the tab bar, 'Test Runs … Playwri', with the text cut through mid-height (0.79–4.0 s; render frame at 23.6 s). It should be the real 'Tue at 3:00 AM · America/New_York' chip. The red-pink underline on 'schedule' underlines 'Test Runs', and the braces frame a broken crop. The beat's single proof is missing.
issues.fix: After the global seek fix, re-crop to the chip as it appears in the rendered frame, place the underline under 'Tue at 3:00 AM' on 'schedule' (b-schedule 2.70), and confirm on a frame from film.mp4 at about 23.4 s.

Measure the three socket positions on the words 'staging', 'preview' and 'local' in that line (or drop the sockets). Never show the personal workers.dev URL. issues.problem: The three product 'stamps' flickering in the gap of '{ intro▢ducing }' (0.40–1.33 s) read as a blank light-grey card. One shows only a faint '…st Runs' (render frame 5.3 s), another is an unreadable thumbnail. The reference's stamps are vivid, saturated images, so this headline beat looks like a placeholder.

issues.problem: 11.3 s on one barely moving composition. For about 2.6 s, from settle (0.9 s) to ms67 (3.5 s), under 'Replay QA caught one in its own app', the Replay player plate is a large empty black rectangle covering about half the frame, which reads as a player that failed to load. The 67 ms bar and the four hollow frames then play at small size with no push-in on 'Four dropped frames'.
issues.fix: Bring the frame ribbon (or a faint plum time ruler with ticks) onto the plate as the screen settles so it is never empty. On 'Sixty-seven' (3.57) zoom 1.0 → 1.5 into the ribbon so the 67 ms bar and the four hollow frames fill the middle of the frame. On 'No click.' (7.67) ease back to the title.

issues.problem: L0508 'It never saved its place, so it kept starting over' (snapback 5.07 to over 7.23, through 7.87 s) has no visible motion. Frames at 5.04, 5.67, 6.12, 7.21 and 7.87 s are identical (258, static histogram, flag parked at the left). The snap-backs the score marks with three plucks never appear on screen.

issues.problem: A struck-through cursor next to the caption '≈ 160 s · 2 clicks · no keypresses' sends mixed signals: a crossed cursor says 'no click', but the caption says 2 clicks.
issues.fix: Strike a keyboard glyph to match 'no keypresses', or drop the strike and keep the plain cursor with '2 clicks'.

issues.fix: Place it fully inside the dark plate near the ribbon, or fully on the haze with 24 px or more clearance.

issues.fix: Strip the backticks and set SidebarProjectList in the mono face.

issues.problem: The giant typed URL is right-anchored with the caret about 80 px from the right frame edge (render frame 9.6 s: caret at x 1838 of 1920), so the line sits right of centre and feels pinned to the edge. The reference keeps the caret about 75–80% across.

issues.problem: The 'collage' reads as a tidy 2×3 grid of thin strips. The reference fans overlapping cards at real depth. The runs tile is cut by the top frame edge (render 76.5 s). issues.fix: Give the tiles more size and overlap at three depths, kept inside the frame with 40 px or more margin. Start the w5/w6 words earlier, or extend the hold by moving the blur dissolve into the head of ch06-s02.
